description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Dark Focus

Benefit: As long as you have a dark spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, you can direct shadows to obscure the vision of one foe within 30 feet as a standard action, giving its attacks a miss chance on a failed Will save. As a secondary benefit, you gain darkvision out to 10 feet, or increase existing darkvision by 10 feet.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Dark Focus
